title: Toshimichi Uzō's My Sweet Marriage to My Ex-Nemesis Light Novels Get TV Anime
content:
Kadokawa announced on Saturday that Toshimichi Uzō 's My Sweet Marriage to My Ex-Nemesis ( Soshiki no Shukuteki to Kekkon Shitara Mecha Amai ) light novel series is getting a television anime adaptation.

Atsushi Nigorikawa ( A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring , Zenryoku Usagi ) is directing the anime at Ankichi Kobo . Keiichirō Ōchi ( The Quintessential Quintuplets , Summer Pockets ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Yūki Nakano ( I'm Quitting Heroing , A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring ) is designing the characters.

The staff also revealed several pieces of character line art, and a celebration illustration from novel illustrator Kewi Hayashi .

One Peace Books describes the manga:

They used to be sworn enemies. Now they' re sworn spouses. Roshi Saigawa and Ritsuka Nagira were once bitter rivals, each fighting for supremacy within rival organizations of superpowered warriors. Their days were filled with duels, schemes, and a rivalry so fierce it seemed nothing could ever bridge the gap between them. Yet, somehow, the impossible has happened— they're now happily married! From bitter enemies to star-crossed lovers, these two have traded their weapons for wedding vows, and their former battles have given way to laughter, love, and the everyday chaos of newlywed life. But just because they've left the battlefield behind doesn't mean life has gotten easier. Old rivalries resurface, secrets linger, and the lines between love, rivalry, and sheer chaos blur in ways neither of them expected. From laugh-out-loud domestic disasters to heart-melting romantic moments, Roshi and Ritsuka are about to prove that falling in love with your enemy isn't just possible— it's explosive. Full of humor, heart, and sizzling chemistry, this enemies-to-lovers rom-com will keep you laughing, swooning, and turning pages until the very last!

Uzō published the first light novel volume in October 2023 under Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint, with illustrations by Kewi Hayashi . The fourth novel volume shipped in August 2025, and the fifth volume will ship on November 10.

Shīme (Si-me) launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Dengeki Maoh magazine in November 2024. Kadokawa published the manga's first compiled book volume in June 2025, and published the second volume on July 27.
author: ANN

title: Rebuild World TV Anime Reveals Main Staff, 1st Key Visual
content:
Kadokawa revealed the main staff and the first key visual on Saturday for the television anime of Nahuse 's Rebuild World light novel series.

Tsukasa Sakurai ( Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For! ; Ryūsatsu no Kyōkotsu director) is the chief director of the anime at Raging Bull , and Shingo Uchida (episode director for Attack on Titan TV 3/2018 , Vinland Saga , After the Rain ) is directing the series. Naoki Tozuka ( I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince both seasons; Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For! ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Hiromi Katō ( Kobato. , Goblin Slayer II , A Returner's Magic Should Be Special both seasons) and others are designing the characters.

Kadokawa announced the anime at Anime Expo in early July 2023, and Dengeki Bunko announced the main cast members later that month. No new information about the anime had been revealed since then, until today.

The anime stars:

• Daiki Yamashita as Akira

• Yurika Kubo as Alpha

• Honoka Inoue as Sheryl

J-Novel Club is releasing the light novels and manga adaptation in English, and it describes the story:

The pinnacle of human civilization has come and gone, leaving only ruins in its wake. Society and science now struggle to rebuild, rediscovering scraps of knowledge from powerful ancient artifacts that defy comprehension. These relics of the “Old World” can make the fortunes of those who find them—if ancient security systems and rogue bioweapons don't kill the relic hunters first. Akira, a young street orphan, sets out to become one such hunter to escape his brutal life in the slums. Untrained, malnourished, and poorly armed, Akira would be lucky to make it back from the ruins alive—until an encounter with Alpha, a mysterious, ghostly woman, changes his fate forever. Alpha needs a hunter, and she's willing to train Akira to get one. Will her support be enough to help a penniless kid from the slums climb to the top of a crushing and merciless world?

Kadokawa publishes the novels by Nahuse with illustrations by Gin (illustrator), yish (environmental artist), and cell (mechanical designer). Nahuse began publishing the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō and Kakuyomu websites in February 2017 and the most recent chapter on the sites was in August 2021. Kadokawa began publishing the series in print in 2019, and will publish the final part of the ninth volume on November 17.

Kirihito Ayamura draws the manga, which launched in July 2019. Kadokawa published the 16th compiled volume on July 27.

The novels ranked at #5 on the tankōbon rankings for the 2020 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Light Novel ga Sugoi! (This Light Novel Is Amazing!) guidebook.

title: 'Biblia Koshodou no Jiken Techou' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo, Spring 2027 Premiere
content:
The Dengeki Bunko Autumn Festival Online 2026 livestream event revealed additional cast, staff, and the first promotional video for the television anime adaptation of En Mikami 's Biblia Koshodou no Jiken Techou ( The Case Files of Biblia Bookstore ) novel on Saturday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in April 2027.

Cast Fumika Shinokawa: Reo Osanai ( Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria ) Fumika Shinokawa: Wataru Takagi ( Kirio Fanclub ) Kikuya Kasai: Youhei Azakami ( Akane-banashi ) Nao Kosuge: Saeko Kamijou ( Gekai Elise )

Staff Assistant Director: Kento Matsui ( Spy x Family episode director) Prop Design: Manami Fukuyo ( Atarashii Joushi wa Do Tennen animation director) Art Director: Masatoshi Kai ( Gimai Seikatsu ) Art Setting: Yoshinori Shiozawa ( Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku art design) Color Design: Kazuko Nakashima ( Nige Jouzu no Wakagimi ) Director of Photography: Teruyuki Kawase ( Buddy Daddies ) Photography Supervisor: Tomoyuki Shiokawa ( Seihantai na Kimi to Boku director of photography) CG Director: Tatsuhiro Ito Editing: Rie Matsubara ( Ninja to Koroshiya no Futarigurashi ) Sound Director: Tomohiko Yaginuma ( Shoushimin Series 2nd Season ) Sound Effects: Shouta Yaso ( Koori no Jouheki )

Mamoru Kanbe ( Shoushimin Series ) is directing the anime at CloverWorks , with Ayako Kurata ( Granblue Fantasy The Animation anime series director) serving as assistant director. Toshiya Oono ( 86 ) is handling the series composition. Jun Nakai ( NieR:Automata Ver1.1a ) is designing the characters, while Takahiro Obata ( Yakusoku no Neverland ) is composing the music.

Mikami began penning the mystery drama novel with illustrations by Hagu Koshijima under the Media Works Bunko label in March 2011. Kadokawa (formerly ASCII Media Works) published the 12th volume on April 24.

Nakano originally began a manga adaptation in Altima Ace in February 2012, which later moved to Monthly Asuka in December 2012 until it concluded in July 2014. Kadokawa published the sixth and final volume in September that year.

Ryou Kouda serialized a second manga adaptation in good! Afternoon from July 2012 to September 2013. Kodansha published the third and final volume in January 2014.

Haruki Niwa began a manga adaptation of the tenth novel volume, subtitled Tobirako to Utsuro na Yume , in Young Ace UP! in February 2024. Kadokawa published the third volume in November 2025.

A live-action drama adaptation aired on Fuji TV in 11 episodes from January to March 2013.

PV 1

title: Antiquarian Bookshop Biblia's Case Files Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, April Debut
content:
The " Dengeki Bunko Fall Festival Online 2026" presented the first full promotional video for the television anime of En Mikami 's Antiquarian Bookshop Biblia's Case Files ( Biblia Koshodō no Jiken Techō ) novel series on Saturday. The video announces more cast and staff members as well as the April 2027 premiere for the anime.

The newly announced cast members are:

• Reo Osanai as Ayaka Shinokawa

• Wataru Takagi as Shida

• Yōhei Azakami as Kikuya Kasai

• Saeko Kamijō as Nao Kosuga

The newly announced staff members are:

• Director Assistant: Kento Matsui

• Prop Design: Manami Fukuyo

• Art Director: Masatoshi Kai

• Art Setting: Yoshinori Shiozawa

• Color Key Artist: Kazuko Nakashima

• Compositing Director of Photography: Teruyuki Kawase (T2 Studio)

• Cinematography Supervisor: Tomoyuki Shiokawa (T2 Studio)

• Cg Director: Tatsuhiro Itō

• Editing: Rie Matsubara

• Sound Director: Tomohiko Yaginuma

• Sound Effects: Shōta Yaso

The series was previously adapted into a live-action television series in 2013. Crunchyroll began streaming the series in 2014, and describes the story:

Shinokawa Shioriko is the proprietor of Biblia Antiquarian Bookshop, her sidekick Goura Daisuke, her lanky gofer and protector, has trouble reading books; they make him dizzy. Shioriko is demure and introverted, an expert on vintage books, a great storyteller, and of course, a lover of books; she also has amazing powers of logical deduction, and can solve big mysteries from the smallest of clues. The unlikely pair join forces to unravel secrets and hidden meanings to help people looking for answers, and the true answers are never what they expect.

The cast for the television anime includes:

Riko Akechi as Shioriko Shinokawa

Shunsuke Takeuchi as Daisuke Gōra

Mamoru Kanbe ( SHOSHIMIN: How to become Ordinary , Sound of the Sky , The Perfect Insider ) is directing the anime at CloverWorks , with Ayako Kurata as assistant director. Toshiya Ono , who has worked with Kanbe in SHOSHIMIN: How to become Ordinary and The Perfect Insider , is in charge of the series scripts. Jun Nakai ( NieR:Automata Ver 1.1a , Silver Spoon , Lord El-Melloi II's Case Files: Rail Zeppelin Grace note ) is designing the characters, and is also the chief animation director. Takahiro Obata is composing the music.

Kadokawa announced in 2017 that the books were inspiring both a live-action film adaptation and an anime film adaptation. While the live-action film eventually opened in November 2018, the anime film project was never released, and had no other information revealed other than the original announcement.

Mikami launched the series in 2011 with the novel "Shioriko-san to Kimyō na Kyakujin-tachi" (Shioriko and the Strange Guests), with art by Hagu Koshijima . The novels have sold over 6.4 million copies, and were nominated for the Japan Mystery Writers Association Award's Long Story category in 2012 and 2014. The 11th novel shipped in March 2024. The novel is divided into two "series," with the first ending on its seventh novel, and the novels currently on their second series.

The novels have three different manga adaptations. The first, by Nakano , debuted in Kadokawa 's Altima Ace magazine, then moved to the Asuka magazine in 2013. The series ended in 2014 with six volumes. The second manga, by Ryō Kōda , launched in Kodansha 's Good! Afternoon magazine in 2012. The manga's third volume shipped in 2014. The third manga, by Haruki Niwa , is titled Biblia Koshodō no Jiken Techō - Tobirako to Utsuro na Yume , and ran in Kadokawa 's Young Ace Up website from February 2024 to October 2025. The manga's third volume shipped in November 2025.

title: 'Romelia Senki' Announces Supporting Cast
content:
The official website for the Romelia Senki ( Romelia War Chronicle ) television anime announced supporting cast on Saturday. The anime series adapting Ryou Ariyama 's action fantasy light novel will air for two cours on Tokyo MX, BS11, Sun TV, and KBS Kyoto starting October 5, with domestic streaming exclusively on Anime Times, U-NEXT, and Netflix beginning October 3 at 9:00 p.m.

Cast Kairo: Mika Kanda ( Migi to Dali ) Zaria: Kenji Hamada ( Yuusha-kei ni Shosu ) Farmaine: Youji Ueda ( Tenmaku no Jaadugar )

Kouji Saitou is helming the anime at Atra . Aya Satsuki ( Kawaisugi Crisis ) is handling the series composition and penning the script. Yoshiko Saitou ( Towa no Yuugure ) and Yuuta Ootaka ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 3rd Season animation director) is designing the characters. KOHTA YAMAMOTO ( Dark Gathering ) is composing the music.

Ariyama originally began penning the action fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in August 2019. Shogakukan began printing the title under its Gagaga Books label in June 2020, featuring illustrations by Kodama . The sixth volume shipped in November 2025.

Ryou Kamito began drawing a manga adaptation on the Manga Doa app in April 2021. Mag Garden released the fifth volume in November 2025.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English in March 2025. The third volume was published on August 11, with the fourth volume scheduled for release on December 1.

title: Sentenced to Be a Hero Smartphone Game Unveils 2nd Visual, 2nd Teaser, Original Characters
content:
Kadokawa unveiled the second teaser key visual and second teaser video for Sentenced to Be a Hero franchise 's new game project titled Yūsha-kei ni Shosu -Game of the GODDESS- ( Sentenced to Be a Hero -Game of the GODDESS- ) on Saturday. The game will be a smartphone game for Android and iOS.

Original light novel author Rocket Shokai is supervising the game's original scenario. The game will feature the following returning cast from the anime:

• Yōhei Azakami as Xylo Forbartz

• Mayu Iizuka as Teoritta

• Shizuka Ishigami as Patausche Kivia

• Shun Horie as Dotta Luzulas

In addition the game will feature new original characters (character name romanizations are not confirmed):

Shokai launched the light novel series on Kadokawa 's Kakuyomu site in October 2020, and Kadokawa began publishing the series in print in September 2021 with illustrations by Mephisto .

The anime debuted on January 3 at 10:00 p.m. on Tokyo MX , with a first episode 60-minute special. The second episode aired on January 15, with subsequent episodes airing on Thursdays. The anime aired on 28 channels across Japan. Amazon Prime Video in Japan started streaming the series on January 3, and other sites started on January 6. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and also streamed a same-day English dub . The anime is getting a second season and Crunchyroll will stream it.

Kadokawa also announced on Saturday it will host a character popularity poll for the anime to commemorate the announcement of the second season. The poll is being held from October 3 to to November 3, and the results will be announced in March 2027.

title: 'Honzuki no Gekokujou: Ryoushu no Youjo' Gets Sequel TV Anime
content:
The 24th and final episode of Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen: Ryoushu no Youjo ( Ascendance of a Bookworm: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke ) ended with an announcement on Saturday that a sequel television anime adaptation of Miya Kazuki 's Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen ( Ascendance of a Bookworm: I'll do Anything to Become a Librarian! ) light novel is in production. The sequel anime, which adapts the fourth part of the light novel, subtitled Kizoku-in no Jishou Tosho Iin , is being produced by WIT Studio .

The anime series produced by Ajia-Do aired across three seasons in Fall 2019, Spring 2020, and Spring 2022. A side story original video anime was bundled with the 22nd volume in March 2020. The fourth season was produced by WIT Studio and aired on April 4. Crunchyroll simulcast the show with subtitles and subsequently began streaming an English dub. Sentai Filmworks licensed the first two seasons and released them on home video in January 2021.

title: Tokyo Ravens Novelist Kōhei Azano Plans to End Series in 18th Volume (Updated)
content:
The school supernatural fantasy light novel series centers around Harutora, a boy from a branch of the Tsuchimikado family of onmyōdō occult practitioners. However, he lacks the ability to see spirit energy, so he is now just an ordinary high school student. Natsume, a girl who was Harutora's childhood friend and the next head of the Tsuchimikado family, reunites with Harutora and changes his future.

Azano launched the Tokyo Ravens light novel series in May 2010 with illustrations by Sumihei . The light novel series inspired a 24-episode television anime in 2013. FUNimation Entertainment streamed the series as it aired in Japan, and also released the series on home video in North America.

Atsushi Suzumi ( Venus Versus Virus , Nightmare Go Round ) launched a manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Monthly Shōnen Ace magazine in 2010, and ended it in July 2017. Kadokawa published the manga's 15th and final compiled book volume in September 2017.

Other manga adaptations of the Tokyo Ravens light novels include Tokyo Ravens: Tokyo Fox , Tokyo Ravens: Sword of Song , Tokyo Ravens: Red and White , Tokyo Ravens: ANOTHER×holiday , and Tokyo Ravens: Girls Photograph .

title: 'Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For!' TV Anime Reveals January 2027 Debut in Video
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed a teaser promotional video on Saturday for the television anime of Shikiso Utsuzawa 's Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For! ( Shin no Seijo de Aru Watashi wa Tsuihō Saremashita. Dakara Kono Kuni wa Mō Owari Desu ) light novel series. The video reveals the anime will debut in January 2027. The video also reveals that Kanako Hara ( Blue Orchestra TV 2 , A Destructive God Sits Next to Me ) is composing the music.

The anime will star Masumi Tazawa as Elian and Taku Yashiro as Nigel.

Tsukasa Sakurai ( The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. , Golden Time , Little Witch Academia episode animation director) is directing the anime at Tsumugi Akita Anime Lab . Naoki Tozuka ( I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince two seasons, Meiji Gekken: 1874 ) is in charge of series scripts, and Naru Nishikōri ( I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince two seasons, Meiji Gekken: 1874 ) is designing the characters.

Kodansha USA Publishing started releasing Matsu's manga adaptation in English digitally in 2024. Kodansha USA describes the story:

Ever since she was a child, Eliane has been the saint and protector of the Kingdom of Belkheim, warding off monsters and ensuring bountiful harvests with her prayers. But when a pretender saint beguiles the foolish prince—to whom she is engaged—into believing she is nothing but a fraud, he calls off the marriage and banishes her from the kingdom. Homeless and penniless but free to chart her own course for the first time in her life, Eliane decides to make for the neighboring kingdom, where she hopes to blend in as a commoner and lead a quiet life…but a chance encounter on the road will totally upend her modest plans.

Utsuzawa launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in June 2020. Kodansha began publishing the light novels with illustrations by Pukyunosuke in January 2021. The seventh volume shipped in Japan in December 2024.

Mokuba Matsu 's manga adaptation debuted April 2021 in Kodansha 's Palcy app. Kodansha released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on July 30. K MANGA is also publishing the manga in English.

title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Novels' Part 4 Gets TV Anime From Wit Studio
content:
The staff for the anime of Miya Kazuki 's Ascendance of a Bookworm ( Honzuki no Gekokujō - Shisho ni Naru Tame niwa Shudan o Erandeiramasen ) light novel series announced on Saturday that the novels' part 4, Founder of the Royal Academy's So-Called Library Committee (Kizoku-in no Jishō Tosho Iin ), will receive a television anime. Wit Studio is once again animating for Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4: Founder of the Royal Academy's So-Called Library Committee .

The Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 3: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke anime premiered on April 4 on the Yomiuri TV and NTV channels at 5:30 p.m. JST (4:30 a.m. EDT), and ended on Saturday. The anime aired across two consecutive cours for a half-year run. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime with English subtitles and an English dub .

Yuka Iguchi and Show Hayami returned in the Part 3 anime as Rozemyne (previously Myne) and Ferdinand, respectively. The anime's new cast members included:

• Yukari Tamura as Georgine

• Mami Koyama as Veronica

• Minami Takayama as Florencia

• Kazuhiro Yamaji as Bonifatius

• Nao Tōyama as Angelica

• Asami Seto as Brigitte

• Katsumi Fukuhara as Zack

Yoshiaki Iwasaki ( Kowloon Generic Romance , Hayate the Combat Butler , We Never Learn: BOKUBEN ) directed the Part 3 anime at Wit Studio , replacing the franchise 's previous director Mitsuru Hongō . Mariko Kunisawa returned to write the series scripts, and Aiko Minowa ( After the Rain , The Ancient Magus' Bride in-between animation) was the new character designer. MICHIRU returned to compose the music.

The first anime season premiered in October 2019, and ended in December 2019 with 14 episodes. The second season premiered in Japan in April 2020. The anime's third season premiered in April 2022. Crunchyroll streamed all three seasons as they aired.

Kazuki began the original novels on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" website in 2013, and ended the web novel in 2017. You Shiina illustrates the print edition. The main series ended with its 33rd volume (volume 12 of part 5) in December 2023. The novel series now has over 13 million copies in circulation (including digital copies).

J-Novel Club is releasing both the light novels and some of the various manga adaptations in English.
